decisions.summary: Add a short package-facing knowledge index and read-only gate so packaged workers can find current runtime docs, operator gates, and safety contracts without scanning repo-local development history.

expected_metrics.target: at least 9.5/10 after current package-facing index is CI-visible

verification_commands.expected: status pass with missing_required_refs 0, forbidden_refs 0, unresolved_links 0, and irreversible_actions 0

observed_results.summary: P25 adds docs/package-knowledge-index.md, README/CLAUDE back-links, schema, CI gate, and release-story coverage. The focused gate reports missing_required_refs 0, forbidden_refs 0, unresolved_links 0, and irreversible_actions 0.

decisions.rollback_or_follow_up: Rollback by removing the CI step and index gate if it proves too brittle; follow up with actual packaging exclusions only after plugin packaging supports a separate ship profile.
